title: Need an easy way to switch all input and output streams from one device to another
line: The Audio Volume widget's device menu can now switch both playback and recording to a headset in one click.
explanation: The Audio Volume widget lists outputs and inputs separately, so moving everything to a headset meant making it the default output and then, separately, the default input. Its device menu only had per-direction actions ("Play all audio via this device", "Record all audio via this device"). The menu of an output or input that belongs to a sound card with the other direction too now has "Play and record all audio via this device", which makes both the card's output and input the defaults and moves all running playback and recording streams to them.

commits.message:
applet: add an action to play and record all audio via one device

Switching a headset or other device that can both play and record took
two separate actions, one for its output and one for its input. Devices
on a card with both now offer one menu action that switches both at once.

BUG: 432120

media.caption: Menu of the USB headset's speaker: only output can be switched from here
Same menu with the fix: new "Play and record all audio via this device" action
Built-in speaker and microphone are the defaults, a call is playing and recording through them
One click on the new action: headset speaker and microphone are both default and the call's streams moved to them

reviews.text: Adding a 'Play and record all audio via this device' action to the Audio Volume device menu is a clean, Plasma-idiomatic way to switch both directions on a physical card in one action without breaking independent input/output selection, and the QPointer lifetime handling is sound. However, the patch does not check whether there is more than one device in the opposite direction, so on the very common setup of a laptop with Built-in Audio plus an output-only HDMI monitor or A2DP Bluetooth headphones (multiple outputs, only one microphone), Built-in Audio Speaker shows a redundant 'Play and record all audio via this device' action right below 'Play all audio via this device' even though there is nothing to switch recording from.
changes: Only search for a counterpart and show 'Play and record all audio via this device' when candidates.size() > 1 (i.e. there are at least two devices in the opposite direction as well as in the current direction).
